Root read the exact extracted implementation/test selections in review chunks0/1 (evidence records, mechanical receipts, source configuration, declaration scanner and unit parser), then supplied per-source rationale and limitations. shared_typing_core independently read all23 raw unit bodies, the complete correspondence-review policy, every extracted implementation/test selection in chunks2–6, and the retained book/MathJax/CSS assets; it reconciled root findings with those selections. rationale: record reloads Inventory before validate_bundle and validates same-unit supersedes targets while retaining immutable records. check derives current bundles, marks any unsuperseded stale decision stale, and checks every active current conclusion; therefore a second positive cannot hide an active mismatch or inconclusive decision. The cited tests mutate sources after loading an Inventory, retain negative decisions alongside a positive, replace a review after adding context, and make a superseding decision stale. Draft and FutureNote branches respectively reject affirmative recording and reject any correspondence review, matching the stated boundaries.
limitations: This review checks source behavior and the assertions in the cited tests. It does not authenticate reviewers or execute the tests.
